1.web: Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.
1.asv: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: Jehovah will deliver him in the day of evil.

2.web: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
2.asv: Jehovah will preserve him, and keep him alive, And he shall be blessed upon the earth; And deliver not thou him unto the will of his enemies.

3.web: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
3.asv: Jehovah will support him upon the couch of languishing: Thou makest all his bed in his sickness.

4.web: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
4.asv: I said, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me: Heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

5.web: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
5.asv: Mine enemies speak evil against me, saying, When will he die, and his name perish?

6.web: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
6.asv: And if he come to see me, he speaketh falsehood; His heart gathereth iniquity to itself: When he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

7.web: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
7.asv: All that hate me whisper together against me; Against me do they devise my hurt.

8.web: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
8.asv: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him; And now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

9.web: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
9.asv: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, Who did eat of my bread, Hath lifted up his heel against me.

10.web: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
10.asv: But thou, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me, and raise me up, That I may requite them.

11.web: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
11.asv: By this I know that thou delightest in me, Because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

12.web: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
12.asv: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, And settest me before thy face for ever.

13.web: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
13.asv: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
